name: kolly
description: Kolly is Malaysia's creator economy platform connecting creators, brands, and agencies — media kits, campaign applications, contracts, and payment tracking in one place.

interface.longDescription: Kolly connects your real Kolly account to ChatGPT. Creators can check earnings and apply to open campaigns. Brands can search the creator directory and review submitted deliverables. Agencies can check roster payout status and update payment state. Every write action goes through the same checks the Kolly dashboard itself enforces — nothing happens that couldn't happen by clicking the equivalent button in the app.
capabilities: Apply to open campaigns on a creator's behalf
Search the creator directory by niche, followers, verification
Approve or request changes on a submitted deliverable
Check agency commission/payout status across a roster
defaultPrompt: What's my earnings summary on Kolly?
